build_column_transformer_pipeline: build a ColumnTransformer pipeline that applies different preprocessing to numeric and categorical features
create_prediction_pipeline: create a full prediction pipeline combining ColumnTransformer preprocessor with LogisticRegression classifier
run_randomized_hyperparameter_search: run RandomizedSearchCV to tune imputer strategy, feature selection percentile, and regularization parameter
select_columns_by_name: select columns by name to dispatch numeric and categorical features to separate transformers
select_columns_by_dtype: select columns by data type using make_column_selector to auto-dispatch categorical and numeric columns
